marketing_description: The Leviton Professional Series R12-AGTR1-0KW GFCI outlet provides 125 V, 15 A protection with a 10 kA interrupt and short‑circuit rating, and features a self‑grounding, back‑wired design in a durable thermoplastic body with brass contacts. Its NEMA 5‑15R configuration, IP54 enclosure and LED indicator meet UL listing requirements, while the tamper‑resistant, IP20 rated housing supports 14‑10 AWG wiring in a wall‑mountable form factor of 1‑17/25 in L × 1.31 in W × 4.19 in H. The device operates from –35 °C to 66 °C and complies with a 1250 V AC dielectric strength for reliable performance in commercial installations.
